children: Sow Good entered into an extension letter amending its Share Purchase Agreement related to a Tanzania transaction. The amendment, signed with the seller group including Ryzon Materials, Uranex Tanzania, Magnis Technologies (Tanzania), and Uranex ESIP, moves the SPA sunset date to October 30, 2026. The extension provides additional time to finalize closing conditions and keep the transaction on track.
